title: 3.8 Canada and Spain
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Recognize Canada/Canadian and Spain/Spanish, answer Where are you from? and say where someone is from.
grammar_function: Where are you from? / Where is he/she from? He/She is from + country. I am + nationality.
prerequisite: 3.7 Where are you from? with Mexico and the United States; 3.4 yes/no questions.
speaking_outcome: Answer Where are you from? as Sofia and Diego and say where someone is from.
